one_sentence_story: Doctors scanned adults before juggling, after 90 days of play, and after 90 days of rest. Brain motion zones grew by 4 percent and shrank halfway back during rest.
so_what_for_you: At 40, 50, or 65, pick up one hand-eye skill like dance or juggling. Play ten minutes a week so your new brain links stay strong.
